title: Phase5 G/I economy baseline bounds and Phase4 combat matrix reuse
basis: Static configured values and existing recorded simulation output only; no source changes, tuning, economy runner or Monte Carlo rerun.

starterSpear.meaning: Crafting recipe id starterSpear outputs ITEM_BASES.spear (item/base ID spear; sell base 14). Sale values use only currently implemented itemSellPrice.
starterSpear.conditions: These are item value bounds conditional on the item being owned, unequipped and sold at a legally accessible blacksmith while open. The sale path is not guaranteed in normal play; Phase4 fresh-save runner remained at hamlet without blacksmith.
starterSpear.excludedPremiums: No affix, quality, provenance, crafter, or masterpiece premium exists in current itemSellPrice.

gatheredMaterialLiquidationOpportunityCo.note: The 18 gold material amount is foregone liquidation value; +4 gold work pay per gather action is a separate acquisition inflow and is not included in this direct item-versus-item opportunity-cost comparison. Stamina and elapsed time are also excluded.

investmentBaseline.classification: Initial investment / gear utility baseline only; not Phase5-G final economy or proof of a profitable/losing stable craft loop. The 18.186 expectation is the unmodified normal wolf rarity profile, not a measured starterSpear craft distribution.

bestOrdinaryDiscount.note: Trade/event penalty can raise price to 1.75x but never discounts below 1.0x; no additional positive reputation discount applies to item buys.

ordinaryBulkBuyBounds.quantityInterface: Current trade action buys one unit per interaction; 10-unit totals below are arithmetic sums of individual buys, not an existing bulk-buy action.
ordinaryBulkBuyBounds.interpretation: At the best ordinary price, bought raw material remains above fixed store sell-back value. The registered starterSpear quantities and fee are known (3 wood + 2 stone + 4 gold); direct bought-input totals are recorded in starterSpear.investmentBaseline. This comparison is only an initial investment/resale baseline, not Phase5-G final economics, craft distribution, or a complete stable-loop finding.

ownershipBuyEffects: Property purchases use separate fixed PROPERTY_DEFINITIONS costs and buyProperty deduction; they do not provide a discount to shop item buyPrice.

powerbands.early: fresh engine character (Lv1/100 HP); controlled initial forest position
powerbands.edge: engine gainExp(180) progression (Lv4 / combat Lv4); no injected gold/world resources
powerbands.ready: actual engine gainExp(300) progression; assertions require hero Lv5 and combat Lv6; every row records both levels

phase4CombatReuse.reuseGuidance: The test harness exposes reusable builders/progression profiles and source-snapshot guard. For Phase5-I, add the crafted equipment build to a new matrix under current frozen source evidence; do not treat old 15-build data as Phase5 results.
